name: ECHO Housing
description: Addresses housing discrimination complaints and ensures equal access to housing
fullDescription: ECHO Housing (Eden Council for Hope and Opportunity) is a HUD-approved housing counseling agency that investigates housing discrimination complaints and provides fair housing counseling and education for residents of Alameda and Contra Costa counties.
whatTheyOffer:
- Housing discrimination counseling and investigation
- Mediation and enforcement of fair housing laws
- Free fair housing education and trainings
- Tenant/landlord counseling
- First-time homebuyer counseling
- Shared housing and rental assistance programs
howToGetIt:
1. Call ECHO at 510-581-9380 or toll-free 855-ASK-ECHO (855-275-3246)
2. Describe your housing situation
3. A counselor reviews your complaint and explains your rights
4. ECHO may investigate, mediate, or help with enforcement
keywords: ECHO, Eden Council for Hope and Opportunity, fair housing, housing discrimination, tenant rights, landlord, complaint, equal housing, Hayward, Oakland, Livermore, Concord
